newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Seven feared drowned off Colombian tourist resort.
newsitem.headline: Seven feared drowned off Colombian tourist resort.

text.p: At least one person died and six others were missing and feared drowned on Monday after a boat capsized in wind-whipped seas off Colombia's Caribbean port of Cartagena, police said.
They said 11 people were plucked to safety after the boat foundered early on Monday. But six others, all believed to be Colombian nationals, disappeared without a trace.
The lifeless body of a seventh person originally listed as missing, a Cartagena medical student identified as Hugo Barrios Castro, was discovered by fishermen on Monday evening.

Cartagena, Colombia's prime tourist resort, has been hit with unusually heavy surf over much of the past three weeks as heavy winds and rains battered much of the central and northern parts of the country.
